evidence.summary: The US Treasury lists State Scientific Research Institute of Mechanical Engineering Imeni V.V. Bakhireva among the 28 entities that are part of the structure of the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), which it calls a large, state-owned Russian defence conglomerate making airborne and naval weapons; OFAC designated them in March 2022. OFAC lists it as linked to KTRV, in Dzerzhinsk.
It belongs to the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), a Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.
